Capital goods are durable assets used by firms to produce other goods and services, such as computers, machinery and equipment, and transport equipment used in production. Intermediate goods are goods that are processed further or incorporated into final products. Intermediate goods include raw materials (e.g. crude oil, iron ore), processed materials (e.g. steel, chemicals), components and parts (e.g. electronic components, auto parts). We excluded semiconductors and fuels from intermediate goods.

But Hefei Model Is Difficult to Replicate
Where does Hefei's success come from?
ITS SUCCESS RELIED ON A RARE ALIGNMENT OF THREE FACTORS
Made bold early bets when strategic sectors were still fragmented.
Committed significant patient capital to anchor future leaders.
Matched investments with Hefei's industrial strengths and ecosystem.
A rare combination—not easy to replicate.
